_comment: Canonical column schema for the team's standard testcase template (assets/Template.xlsx). AI reads this file directly — no need to scan the Excel or Sheet header row. Update here if the template ever changes.

execution_contract.execution_rule: Prefer matching .automation.json and run its structured steps in order with exact entry, values, assertions and cleanup
execution_contract.manifest_rule: Join Sheet rows and automation manifest by exact testcase_id; local Excel auto-discovers the same-basename sidecar and remote Sheet accepts --manifest
execution_contract.legacy_rule: Parse F/G/H only when no manifest exists; text-only rows require scoped normalization and unresolved route, role, data, target, transition or expected result is Untest or BLOCKED
execution_contract.selector_rule: Semantic target hints are candidates only; locator must be verified in the same runtime browser session with count=1, visible=true and actionable=true when applicable

workflow_composition.name: SHEET_EXECUTION_PLUS
workflow_composition.conditional_layer: Original Retest only for rows linked to a Plane ticket or previous failure
workflow_composition.plane_mutation_rule: Do not comment or change Plane state without an exact ticket
confirmation_gates: All workers, selected worker IDs, or cancel
workflow_composition.module_rule: A module named in the prompt is a requested filter and must be confirmed before execution
workflow_composition.single_module_sharding: Split one module across the confirmed worker count without duplicating testcase rows
workflow_composition.visual_evidence_rule: Every Pass and Fail testcase requires at least one existing screenshot or video; JSON, trace, console, or network evidence alone is insufficient
workflow_composition.evidence_placement_rule: Local media must be written under the testcase evidence_directory assigned by the executor
